predictions.B1a: 全局均值差。H-cancel：R_1 ≤ 0.20（在一圈上取平均时，状态分量互相抵消）；对立 H-shift：R_1 ≥ 0.80。
predictions.B1b: 单对均值差。R_1(起点 = x₀) ≥ 0.80，且其他起点的平均 R_1 ≤ 0.20；全体 R_2 ≤ 0.20。对立：其他起点的平均 R_1 ≥ 0.50。
predictions.B1c: 按读出索引的均值差。H-state-aware：单向 R_2N ≥ 0.90；对立：≤ 0.50。
predictions.B2: LoReFT。H-objective：LoReFT-C1 的 R_1 ≥ 0.90、R_2 ≤ 0.20、D ≥ 0.80；LoReFT-C3U4 的 R_2N ≥ 0.95。对立 H-param：LoReFT-C1 的 R_2N ≥ 0.90。
predictions.B3: 容量。H-objective：满秩线性与 MLP 都满足 R_2 ≤ 0.20 且 D ≥ 0.80。对立 H-capacity：R_2N ≥ 0.90。
predictions.B4: 展开视野。H-counter：U8、U16 的 R_{S_max+2} ≤ 0.50，Urand 的 R_4N ≤ 0.50。对立 H-state：任一编辑器的 R_4N ≥ 0.90。（判定只用通过准入的编辑器；DEVIATIONS 5）
predictions.B5: 解析旋转。H-sufficient：单向 R_2N ≥ 0.95；对立：≤ 0.50。
predictions.B6: 解码后重编码（参照，不是预测）：报告 R_2N 与每步墙钟时间。
predictions.S: 每个格子；判定只用 5 个新 seed：C1 的 R_1 ≥ 0.90 且 R_2 ≤ 0.20 的 seed ≥ 4/5；C3-U4 的单向 R_2N ≥ 0.95 的 seed ≥ 4/5。报告全部 8 个 seed 的最小值与最大值。
predictions.DO3: （主）谱：s_1 在全部平面中最小。
predictions.DO6: （主）潜空间预测器：一致率 ≥ 0.85，相对朴素判断的提升 CI 下界 > 0，类别准确率 ≥ 0.80。
predictions.DO: DO1a 与 DO2–DO6 都成立，记为该组合"复现"。两个模型都复现，论文的标题与摘要才可以写 decoder-only。
predictions.G9_0: 锁定后的健全性闸门：基算子 RRR-16 与 S-RRR_nat 在所用 confirm 集上的单向 R_2N ≥ 0.95；不通过即停止排查。

operational.general: Paths start at the world start; 2N steps (plus, minus, alternating), B4 4N. R_k = fraction of worlds whose decoded output is a success at every step 1..k. Template 0 on confirm7 (= confirm6; text reused, first evaluation for every v9 editor and the second decoder-only model), month-nat on confirm8. R values of single-path predictions on the plus path. Seed medians over the admitted seeds of a cell; an editor that could not learn counts as R = 0 in S and B2 / B3 medians (admission rule), and B4 is judged on admitted editors only (DEVIATIONS 5). D = among worlds with a parsable step-1 decode, the share whose locked step-1 readout (sim9 / do_sim) differs from the decoded state.
operational.precheck: DEVIATIONS 3: latent simulation on dev only; a condition the simulated slot readout puts on the other side of its threshold is dropped (exploratory); B5 descriptive if the simulated R_2N >= 0.95; R_1 of CE editors and D not pre-checked.
operational.B_rules: B1a: H-cancel R_1 <= 0.20, H-shift >= 0.80, else mixed. B1b: holds iff its kept conditions hold; opposing iff other-start mean R_1 >= 0.50. B1c: >= 0.90 H-state-aware, <= 0.50 opposing. B2: H-objective iff LoReFT-C1 medians R_1 >= 0.90, R_2 <= 0.20 (if kept), D >= 0.80 and LoReFT-C3U4 median R_2N >= 0.95 (if kept); H-param iff LoReFT-C1 median R_2N >= 0.90; else mixed. B3: H-objective iff Full-C1 and MLP-C1 both have median R_2 <= 0.20 (if kept) and D >= 0.80; H-capacity iff either has median R_2N >= 0.90. B4: per variant the admitted seeds; variants with < 2 admitted descriptive; H-state iff an admitted editor has R_4N >= 0.90; H-counter iff every non-descriptive variant has median R_{S_max+2} (U8, U16) resp. R_4N (Urand) <= 0.50. B5: >= 0.95 H-sufficient, <= 0.50 opposing (descriptive if so pre-checked). S: per (backbone, domain) the new seeds 45-49.
operational.DO_rules: Per (model, domain) at the model's layer; readout = equal-weight plane readout (lambda_k = 1 / median one-step distance on train latents). DO1a, DO2 (kept conditions), DO3 (argmin of the confirm one-step change s_k is the fundamental), DO4 (C1 medians), DO5 (C3-U4 median R_2N), DO6 (agreement, CI lower bound of latent - naive > 0, category accuracy over cells >= 0.80). A combination replicates iff DO1a and DO2-DO6 hold; combinations whose reconstruction gate failed are not evaluated.
operational.paper: PLAN v9 section 7 maps every outcome to the paper.

seed_registry.rule: PLAN v7 design rule 3; procedure excludes the number of updates (prefix runs)

Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct.note: token check: 8 of 960 month-nat worlds not single-token; excluded for Qwen only (DEVIATIONS 2)

do_gate2.rule: first candidate with dev reconstruction >= 0.99 on weekday and month template 0
do_gate2.lead_decision: 2026-11-28: SmolLM2 evaluated on weekday only; gate per combination (DEVIATIONS 6)
